entities.title: Page
entities.summary: The game's HTML page, its styles and the headers Cloudflare serves with it.
entities.purpose: Holds what the build copies unchanged into dist/: index.html with the canvas, the touch buttons, the bar under the field (sound, pause, the online status line and a link to the high scores) and the site links; style.css; and _headers with the content security policy and permissions policy.
boundaries: No script of its own: the build adds game.js from src/main.ts, and the page loads the games hub's /games/play.js.
_headers is moved to the assets root by the build, so it applies to every static file.
